div.head: IV Atr 3.3
div.ab: Si cacepollum aduocet, quod ei teloneum dedit, et ille neget, perneget ad Dei iudicium et in nulla alia lada.
Si cacepollum advocet quod ei teloneum dedit, et ille neget, perneget ad Dei iudicium et in nulla alia lada.
Wenn er sich auf den Steuerbüttel beruft, dass er diesem den Zoll gezahlt habe, und dieser leugnet, so reinige sich [jener Verklagte] im Gottesurtheile und in keinem anderen Beweismittel.
If he appeals to the toll-collector, [saying] that he paid him the toll, and the latter denies it, let [the accused] clear himself by the judgment of God [the ordeal] and by no other means of proof.
If he vouches the tax-gatherer to warranty [asserting] that he paid toll to him, and the latter denies it, he shall clear himself by the ordeal and by no other means of proof.
